text_block_list.text:
The first three years are said to be
pivotal in
every Umamusume's career,
and Кинг Хало has
just put those three
years to rest.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
This program will cover her journey
through and
beyond her sudden change
of course which
shocked the world and
brought her to where she
is now.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. I suppose I'm not having a bad
time right
now.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Not, er, bad, you say?
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
Ah, the close coverage on my career
starts today,
doesn't it?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Excuse what I said. Anyway... did you
have any
questions?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm actually somewhat curious as to why
you'd
describe now as "not a bad time"
instead of a
"good time."
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so? Well, I don't mind
enlightening
you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
"Good" is a word you say when you feel
satisfied,
correct? Considering that, I
find "not bad" to be a
more apt choice.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As a first-rate Umamusume, I cannot be
content
with my current level of
achievements.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
With that said, I actually have a meeting
with my
trainer now. We can continue
this another time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Pick up the pace! We must leave
in style, just
like we practiced!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Keep your back straight! Get a hold of
yourself already!
The cameras are still on
us!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: And then, Кинг Хало and her trainer left.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
The next day, we visited Кинг Хало on
the track
before for a race.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. I see you've come today as
well. How
diligent.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well, there is a reason we call it close coverage.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In that case, I'll grant you the
right to
capture something special
today.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And by that, I mean the victory I'm
about to
seize.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
However, the race tragically ends with
first place
seized by another.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text: So...
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to be nervous. Don't
you have a
job to do?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I may have not taken first place in
today's race,
but it doesn't change who I
am.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I graciously accept the outcome, no
matter what
it may be. Experience
provides the energy
needed to move
forward.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: That is my ethos.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You have a strong will.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text: Heh. Does that surprise you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just where does that fighting spirit come
from?
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
That's a good question, to which I have
but one
thing I can say.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It matters not whether my competition is
a genius
or a legend.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll continue to be myself and follow my
own path.
I am Кинг Хало and I hold my
head high with
pride.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No matter the path I take, it will
eventually lead
me to victory! The last
laugh will be mine!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало marches forward without
looking back.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes, for that is the departure
of a
first-rate Umamusume whose glow
gives light to
the Golden Generation.
text_block_list.name: Program Narrator

text_block_list.text: Wasn't that great?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That was the best interview in the history
of
interviews! Could I have been any
more
charismatic?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Did you hear what they said? "A
first-rate
Umamusume whose glow gives
light to the
Golden Generation."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I loved it! Hehe. ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare delete this video,
Trainer! It must
be preserved in
perpetuity!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Clang.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
King, that was awesome! When did that
interview
even happen?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: How is this possible?! I wanted to be the face of our generation!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It was exactly what I expected
from a
program covering King.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally. Her nagging at her trainer
was so
true to life.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
What?! That's so far from what was
remarkable
about the program! What
about my—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, the room is suddenly
filled with
lively voices.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there's one other thing in
particular
about the program that made
me happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You were mumbling just now. If there's
something
you want to say, then speak
up.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I thought it was a good program.

text_block_list.text:
In the program, they spoke of Кинг Хало
as a
racer, as an Umamusume—as herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There was no mention of "her mother's
daughter"
at all, and they even went as
far as to call her
"first-rate."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. They showcased my
talents
properly and thoroughly.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: The first-rate Umamusume, Кинг Хало! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She shows me her large, trademark
smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She most certainly is a first-rate
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
